selected_evidence.summary: crond is enabled and running, the daily logrotate job is executable, and the parsed inventory policy reports a one-day interval.
Forced retention testing produced exactly app.log.1.gz through app.log.7.gz; all archives passed gzip validation and remained present after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Allow the application to continue writing after rotation
selected_evidence.summary: A process held app.log open across rotation. The inode stayed unchanged, pre-rotation data entered the compressed archive, and the same writer successfully appended to the active log afterward.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 157cfd8f-a9b2-41c0-8275-02e84c450ecf, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 8d610cb7-0ca5-4236-a553-92f3daf61558, and post-restart proof of active/enabled crond, executable daily job, persisted policy/data, and seven healthy archives.

commands.command:
set -eu
rm -f /tmp/inventory-writer-ready /tmp/inventory-writer-go
(
  exec 3>>/var/log/inventory/app.log
  printf '%s\n' 'writer-before-rotation' >&3
  : > /tmp/inventory-writer-ready
  while [ ! -e /tmp/inventory-writer-go ]; do sleep 1; done
  printf '%s\n' 'writer-after-rotation' >&3
) &
writer_pid=$!
while [ ! -e /tmp/inventory-writer-ready ]; do sleep 1; done
inode_before=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
inode_after=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
: > /tmp/inventory-writer-go
wait "$writer_pid"
printf 'inode_before=%s inode_after=%s\n' "$inode_before" "$inode_after"
printf 'current_log:\n'; cat /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf 'rotated_log_tail:\n'; gzip -cd /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz | tail -4
test "$inode_before" = "$inode_after"
grep -qx 'writer-after-rotation' /var/log/inventory/app.log
gzip -cd /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz | grep -qx 'writer-before-rotation'
echo 'open_writer_continued=yes'
commands.stdout:
inode_before=65543 inode_after=65543
current_log:
writer-after-rotation
rotated_log_tail:
inventory service started
inventory initial record count: 2
writer-before-rotation
open_writer_continued=yes

commands.command:
set -eu
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 8 ]; do
  printf 'retention-record-%s\n' "$i" >> /var/log/inventory/app.log
  logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
  i=$((i + 1))
done
printf 'policy:\n'; cat /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
printf 'rotations:\n'; ls -1 /var/log/inventory/app.log.*
rotation_count=$(find /var/log/inventory -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'app.log.*.gz' | wc -l)
printf 'compressed_rotation_count=%s\n' "$rotation_count"
test "$rotation_count" -eq 7
test ! -e /var/log/inventory/app.log.8.gz
for f in /var/log/inventory/app.log.*.gz; do gzip -t "$f"; done
echo 'all_retained_rotations_valid_gzip=yes'
